div.l: And eủery creek / in bretayne and in Spayne
His barge was cleped / the Magdeleyne
A Doctour of PhisykWIth vs ther was also / a Doctour of Phisyk
In al this world / was ther noon hym lyk
To speke of phisik / and surgerye
For he was grownded / in astronomye
He kepte his pacient pacie pacient / a wel gret del
In houris bi his magik / naturel
Wel cowde he / the Fortune accident
Of his ymages / for his pacient
He knew the cause / of euery maladye
Were it of hoot cold / moyst or drye
And were engendred / of what humour
He was a verray / parfit practisour
The cause he knew / and of his harm the roote
A noon he yaf the syke mān / his boote
Wel reedy had he / his appotecarijs
For eche of hem / maketh other for to wynne
To sende hym dragmys / of his letuarijs
Here frendshepe / was nat new to bigynne
Wel knew he tholde Esculapius
And diascorides / and eke Rufus
Olde ypocras / haly / and Galien
Serapion Razis / and auyzen
Auerois / Damascien / and Constantyn
Bernard / and Gatisden / and Gelbertyn
Of his diet / mesurable / was he
For it was / of noon suꝑperfluite
But of gret norishyng and digestible
His study was but lytyl / on the bible
In sangveyne and in perce / he clad was al
Lyned with taffata / and with sendal
And yet he was but esy / of dispense
